summary.key_theme: 亞馬遜在 AI 領域積極布局與 Anthropic 合作，但因封鎖 Meta 的 Muse AI 引發競爭對手結盟風險，且面臨勞工訴訟與監管壓力。

bullish.title: Merchants Can Now Add Fast, Free Prime Delivery to Their Websites and Save Up to 25% on Fulfillment Fees with Amazon Supply Chain Services
bullish.reason: 亞馬遜推出新的供應鏈服務，協助商家降低 25% 履約費用，有助於鞏固其電商生態系統的競爭優勢。

bullish.title: Amazon Opens Seller Data to Claude Days After Blocking Meta’s Muse
bullish.reason: 亞馬遜將賣家數據開放給 Anthropic 的 Claude，顯示其在 AI 策略上傾向支持自有生態系與合作夥伴，強化 AWS 的 AI 競爭力。

bullish.title: Here's My Top Reason to Buy Amazon Stock Right Now
bullish.reason: 分析師強調 AWS 的快速成長仍是亞馬遜股價的核心驅動力，維持長期看多觀點。

bullish.title: Amazon rolls out safety tech, pay bump for delivery providers
bullish.reason: 透過導入安全技術與調薪，有助於提升物流效率並降低長期營運風險。

bullish.title: Will Amazon's Agentic AI Strategy Unlock Big Upside for the Stock Now?
bullish.reason: 探討代理 AI 在廣告與 AWS 的應用潛力，雖有資本支出疑慮，但長期成長空間受市場關注。

bearish.title: Amazon Blocked Meta’s Shopping Bot, So Zuckerberg Cut A Deal With Amazon’s Biggest Rival
bearish.reason: 亞馬遜封鎖 Meta 的 Muse AI 導致 Meta 與 Shopify 等競爭對手結盟，可能削弱亞馬遜在電商流量的壟斷地位。

bearish.title: $2.5 billion Amazon Prime settlement update: See if you qualify for a $200 payout and learn how to cancel unwanted subscriptions
bearish.reason: FTC 修訂和解協議，將賠償上限提高至 200 美元，增加公司法律與合規成本。

bearish.title: Amazon Faces Another Worker Lawsuit. Is Employment Scrutiny Becoming an Investor Risk?
bearish.reason: 持續的勞工訴訟增加人力資源管理風險，可能影響公司聲譽與營運成本。

bearish.title: Amazon Stock Dips After $100 Million Indiana Manufacturing Push
bearish.reason: 市場對亞馬遜在機器人製造領域的 1 億美元資本支出反應冷淡，擔憂短期獲利能力。

bearish.title: Trump discloses more than 1,100 July trades, including up to $25 million sales of Microsoft and Amazon
bearish.reason: 川普披露出售價值高達 2,500 萬美元的亞馬遜股票，雖為個人財務操作，但可能引發市場對大型科技股估值的擔憂。

neutral.title: Microsoft vs. Amazon: Which AI Cloud Stock Converts Capex Into Profits Better?
neutral.reason: 比較微軟與亞馬遜在 AI 資本支出轉化為獲利的效率，屬於中性的產業分析報告。

neutral.title: Waymo Takes On Zoox in Las Vegas. Is Alphabet Winning the Robotaxi Race?
neutral.reason: 討論亞馬遜旗下的 Zoox 與 Waymo 在無人計程車市場的競爭，目前影響力尚不明顯。

neutral.title: Update: Market Chatter: Anthropic, OpenEvidence Team Up to Expand Medical AI Globally
neutral.reason: 亞馬遜投資的 Anthropic 進行醫療 AI 合作，對亞馬遜股價影響間接且有限。

neutral.title: Final Trades: Amazon, Check Point, Micron and Apple
neutral.reason: 投資委員會將亞馬遜列為下半年觀察名單，未提供明確買賣建議。

neutral.title: Kraft Heinz launches mac and cheese cream soda in Canada
neutral.reason: 僅為單一商品在亞馬遜平台上架，對整體營收影響微乎其微。
